title: MassSpecPreppy-An end-to-end solution for automated protein concentration determination and flexible sample digestion for proteomics applications
protocol_category: proteomics sample prep (BCA, SP3 digestion, Evotip loading)
results_evidence: BCA assay average recovery 101.3% (SD 7.82%) vs 96.3% manual; 94.5% of protein groups passed significance for OT-2 digestion vs 95% manual.
readiness_reason: 10 OT-2 apiLevel .py templates (BCA, SP3 digestion, Evotip loading) generated by Shiny app; GPL-3.0; quantitative validation; overlaps thematically with proteomics-digestion-workflow but distinct paper/code.

title: Enabling high-throughput enzyme discovery and engineering with a low-cost, robot-assisted pipeline
protocol_category: transformation, protein expression and Ni-bead purification of 96 enzymes
results_evidence: Purified 96 PET hydrolases in parallel with yields up to 400 ug, reproducible purity, thermostability and activity benchmark dataset.
readiness_reason: 21 OT-2 apiLevel scripts (transformation, cherry-picking, mag-bead wash/elution, transfers) but repo has no LICENSE; otherwise strong.

title: TidyTron: Reducing lab waste using validated wash-and-reuse protocols for common plasticware in Opentrons OT-2 lab robots
protocol_category: plasticware decontamination / tip and plate washing
results_evidence: Validated cleaning of tips and plates contaminated with DNA, E. coli and S. cerevisiae (qPCR/growth-based residual contamination measured across cleaning solutions and contact times).
readiness_reason: 37 OT-2 apiLevel scripts, Apache-2.0, OA SLAS Technology, quantitative validation; repetitive variants so a few distinct tasks.

title: Implementation of an efficient SARS-CoV-2 specimen pooling strategy for high throughput diagnostic testing
results_evidence: Infected samples reliably detected in pools of 27 and 81 with minimal sensitivity loss for individual Ct up to 32.
readiness_reason: 4 pooling scripts use the deprecated Opentrons v1 API (from opentrons import robot); would need porting to v2; MIT.

title: Modular development enables rapid design of media for alternative hosts
results_evidence: Modular blended media improved Pichia pastoris biomass accumulation and heterologous protein titre in mL-scale batch fermentations.
readiness_reason: Python package generates OT-2 plate-prep protocols (opentrons imports; one apiLevel calibration file); needs wrapper to produce a standalone simulate-able protocol; MIT.

title: High-Throughput DNA Extraction Using Robotic Automation (RoboCTAB) for Large-Scale Genotyping
results_evidence: DNA yield and quality from leaves and roots sufficient for SNP genotyping/sequencing; compared tissue types for yield.
readiness_reason: Clean OT-2 and Flex versions of the CTAB script (good OT-2 vs Flex pair) but repo has no LICENSE file.

title: PASTA: versatile tyramide-oligonucleotide amplification for multimodal spatial biology
protocol_category: spatial proteomics staining (tyramide-oligo amplification cycles on slides)
results_evidence: High-plex protein and RNA codetection on FFPE tissue via cyclical tyramide-oligonucleotide amplification and imaging (Nature Methods figures).
readiness_reason: Single OT-2 apiLevel 2.7 script for oligo-HRP staining cycles; no LICENSE; custom slide labware likely needed.

title: A linear programming-based strategy to save pipette tips in automated DNA assembly
protocol_category: DNA assembly reaction setup with tip-saving optimisation
results_evidence: Algorithm reduced pipette tip consumption in randomly generated and real-life modular DNA assembly scenarios (computational; runtime estimated via opentrons simulate).
readiness_reason: Mainly an optimiser; robot code is a runtime-estimation wrapper plus related DAMPLAB/OT2-MoClo-Transformation-Ecoli templates in v1 API (BSD); no wet-lab validation of the optimised runs.

title: Enhancing bioreactor arrays for automated measurements and reactive control with ReacSight
protocol_category: bioreactor sampling / cytometry loading, reactive control
results_evidence: Real-time optogenetic control of yeast gene expression, competition assays under nutrient scarcity, and dynamic control of two-strain consortium composition.
readiness_reason: OT-2 driven via Flask server using opentrons.execute and smoothie driver internals (not a protocol file); hardware-integrated (bioreactors, cytometer); repo here is a later project fork, original code on Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.4776009; no license.

title: An open-source automated PEG precipitation assay to measure the relative solubility of proteins with low material requirement
protocol_category: protein solubility assay (PEG titration, plate prep and transfer)
results_evidence: Relative solubility of proteins/antibodies quantified from PEG-precipitation midpoints using ~200 ug material; accuracy compared against established methods.
readiness_reason: Two OT-2 API v2 scripts (step1 PEG gradient setup, step2 transfer after centrifugation) with clear paper protocol; no LICENSE; may need aluminium-block labware definitions.

title: Workflow to Select Functional Promoter DNA Baits and Screen Arrayed Gene Libraries in Yeast
protocol_category: yeast transformation / arrayed library inoculation (Y1H screening)
results_evidence: Robotized yeast one-hybrid workflow for screening arrayed Arabidopsis TF libraries against promoter fragment baits (interaction readouts reported).
duplicate_of_existing: lap-transposon-genotyping (same LAPrepository code repo; different paper)
readiness_reason: Uses LAP-CellMediaInoculation-OT2 scripts (apiLevel) driven by Excel variables files; repo has no license file; repo already in corpus via lap-transposon-genotyping.

title: Automated, high-throughput in situ hybridization of sea urchin (Lytechinus pictus) embryos
protocol_category: whole-mount in situ HCR on embryos in 96-well plates
results_evidence: Processed 192 probe sets in 32 h; produced localisation data for 101 genes across three developmental stages.
readiness_reason: Protocol is an Opentrons Flex Protocol Designer JSON (schema v8), not Python; could be exported/converted; no license.
